question: Hemolysis in a serum sample interferes with the determination of the enzyme lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) due to:

options.opa: The release of adenylate cyclase (catalyst enzyme of the reaction).
options.opc: The high concentration of said enzyme in the cytoplasm of erythrocytes.
options.opd: Hemolysis does not interfere in the determination of LDH.
options.ope: The amount of lactate that is produced.
